QuestInfo.name: Student of the Really Old
QuestInfo.0: You reached the Magic Library but you can't find Grendel the Really Old. Where is he?
QuestInfo.1: You reached the Magic Library but you can't find Grendel the Really Old. Where is he?
QuestInfo.2: Grendel the Really Old left to take care of some business. Maybe Lolo can help you out.

0.0: Hullo. I'm Lolo. Can I help you?\r\n#L0##bGreetings, child. I seek the man known as Grendel.#l\n#k
0.1: Sorry. Master Grendel just stepped out.\r\n#L0##bWhen will he return?#l\n#k
0.2: Boy, I should have asked him when he left. That would've been a great idea! Oh well. I can take a message, if you like.\r\n#L0##bPerhaps you can help me. What do you know of Aurora?#l\n#k
0.3: Aurora. Aurora Aurora Aurora. That DOES sound familiar. Where did I hear that before...?

yes.0: Hm. Maybe this will help you.

no.0: Okay. Thanks for visiting your local library!
